```python
def solve(case):
    segments = case["segments"]
    budget = case["budget"]
    
    n = len(segments)
    
    # Validate required fields
    for seg in segments:
        if "name" not in seg or "importance" not in seg or "minimum" not in seg or "capacity" not in seg:
            raise ValueError("Missing required field in segment")
    
    quota_sum = sum(seg["minimum"] for seg in segments)
    total_capacity = sum(seg["capacity"] for seg in segments)
    
    if budget < quota_sum or budget > total_capacity:
        raise ValueError("Budget out of valid range")
    
    # Initialize at minimum
    allocs = [seg["minimum"] for seg in segments]
    remaining = budget - quota_sum
    
    # Distribute remaining tokens
    while remaining > 0:
        best_idx = -1
        best_priority = -1
        for i, seg in enumerate(segments):
            if allocs[i] >= seg["capacity"]:
                continue
            priority = seg["importance"] / (allocs[i] + 1)
            if priority > best_priority:
                best_priority = priority
                best_idx = i
        if best_idx == -1:
            break  # all at capacity
        allocs[best_idx] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    
    by_name = {seg["name"]: allocs[i] for i, seg in enumerate(segments)}
    
    return {
        "allocations": allocs,
        "by_name": by_name,
        "total": sum(allocs)
    }
```
